reason: The README clearly describes a dsh Harness Web UI theme plugin that applies Palenight dark and warm-neutral light palettes through theme token overrides, with optional demo UI and host capabilities in its deprecated dynamic form.

summaries.zh: 为 dsh Harness Web UI 提供可持久化的 Palenight 深色主题和暖中性色浅色主题，并覆盖界面颜色与代码块等视觉变量。
summaries.en: Provides persistent Palenight dark and warm-neutral light themes for the dsh Harness Web UI, including visual token overrides for surfaces, controls, text, and code blocks.

capabilities: Applies persistent light and dark UI theme token overrides
Adds minor browser-side UI elements in the dynamic plugin form
Provides optional host-side demo RPC handlers and a demo model-visible tool in the dynamic form
